messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

You need to take Gabapentin regularly over several weeks for the full pain-relieving effect to develop.
Triplet: ["Gabapentin", "has time to full effect", "several weeks"]

The relation 'has time to full effect' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug requires the time period specified by the object entity to achieve its complete therapeutic effect.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has availability date': The subject drug has been available since the time period specified by the object entity.
B. 'has half life': The subject drug has a specific duration of time for its half-life, as specified by the object entity.
C. 'has onset of effect': The subject drug starts to work or shows its effect within the time period specified by the object entity.
D. 'has duration of treatment': The subject drug is typically taken for the length of time specified by the object entity.
E. 'has clinical importance': The subject drug has a clinically significant characteristic or requirement specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
